question.text:
Given below are two statements: One is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R.

Assertion A:  can be easily reduced using Zn-Hg/HCl to 

Reason R: Zn-Hg/HCl is used to reduce carbonyl group to –CH2 – group.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A is false but R is true
A is true but R is false
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

solution.text:
Clemmensen reduction: The carbonyl group of aldehydes and ketones is reduced to CH2 group on treatment with zinc-amalgam and concentrated hydrochloric acid.

The acid sensitive alcohol group reacts with HCl, hence Clemmenson reduction is not suitable for above conversion.

So, assertion is false but reason is true.
